meta.title: MALIKA — Elegance, Reimagined
meta.description: MALIKA is a luxury fashion house. Discover refined, feminine pieces designed with quiet confidence.

footer.about: A house of quiet, considered fashion — made to be lived in.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.intro: Every token below is drawn from the MALIKA logo: the wine-burgundy of the lettering and the warm copper of its fine outline.
designSystem.colorsNote: Wine and copper are sampled directly from the logo. Cream and sage are supporting neutrals.
designSystem.typeBody: Body — clear, calm and readable at every size.

errors.notFoundTitle: This page is not available yet
errors.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or is still being built.

hero.title: Elegance, Reimagined.
hero.subtitle: Considered silhouettes, soft tailoring and quiet details — made for the woman who needs no introduction.

newCollection.title: A softer way to dress
newCollection.body: Warm wine, copper and cream — a palette taken from the heart of the house. Fluid fabrics, precise cuts, pieces that move with you.

editorial.title: Quiet luxury, loudly felt
editorial.body: MALIKA is built on restraint: fewer, better pieces; fabrics chosen by hand; finishing that you notice only when you wear them. This is fashion without noise.

promo.title: Complimentary delivery on your first order

shop.subtitle: Considered pieces for every day and every evening.
shop.emptyBody: Try removing a filter or browse the full collection.

product.sizeGuideNote: Measurements in centimetres, taken on the body.
product.shippingBody: Delivery within 2–5 working days across Egypt. Free delivery on your first order.
product.returnsBody: Unworn items with tags can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

collectionsPage.title: Collections
collectionsPage.intro: Each collection is a chapter: a mood, a palette, a point of view.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The browsable taxonomy of the boutique — every product sits inside exactly one category.
categories.emptyBody: Create the first category so products have a home.
categories.slugHint: Leave blank to generate it from the English name.

products.title: Products
products.intro: Every piece in the boutique: identity, story, pricing, imagery and the variants that carry stock.
products.newIntro: Give the piece a name, its story, its pricing and at least one size-and-colour variant.
products.editIntro: Changes go live on the storefront as soon as you save.
products.emptyBody: Adjust the filters, or add the first piece of the season.
products.slugHint: Leave blank to generate it from the English name.
products.imagesHint: First image is used as the card cover. A solid colour stands in until a photo exists.
products.noImages: No images yet — add one so the piece is not shown as an empty panel.
products.errVariantsRequired: Add at least one variant with a SKU, size and colour.
products.errDuplicateSku: Two variants share the same SKU — each code must be unique.
products.errDuplicateVariant: Two variants share the same size and colour.
products.noCollections: No collections yet — create one to merchandise this piece.
products.tipSku: SKU and variant codes must be unique across the store.
products.tipStock: Variant stock changes are recorded in the inventory log.
products.tipSlug: The slug becomes the product's web address.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.intro: Stock across every size and colour, with an audited trail for every movement.
inventory.emptyBody: Adjust the filters to find a variant.
inventory.readOnly: You can view movements, but adjusting stock needs the inventory permission.

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Seasonal edits and stories — each one groups products under a single address.
collections.emptyBody: Create the first edit of the season.
collections.slugHint: Leave blank to generate it from the English name.

homepage.title: Homepage
homepage.intro: Arrange the blocks that build the storefront home page, switch any of them on or off, and edit what each one shows.
homepage.dragHint: Drag a row by its handle to reorder it, or use the up and down buttons — both do the same thing.

fields.overlayHint: Between 0 and 0.8 — the lower the number, the clearer the picture.
fields.countdownHint: A date and time shown as a live countdown; leave empty to hide it.
fields.badgeHint: A short label above the heading; leave empty for none.
fields.countHint: Leave empty to use the section default.
fields.animationHint: Optional effect name, e.g. fade or rise.
fields.layoutHint: Optional arrangement name, e.g. split or stack.
fields.itemsHint: One item per line, up to 12 lines.

banners.title: Banners
banners.intro: Campaign messages shown across the storefront — each with its own placement, tone and schedule.
banners.emptyBody: Create a banner to run a campaign on the storefront.

fields.hrefHint: Required as soon as a button label is written.

pages.title: Pages
pages.intro: Standalone pages — About, FAQ, privacy and terms — written in both languages and served at their own address.
pages.newIntro: Choose an address, write both titles, then the content in the two languages.
pages.editIntro: Every change is published to the storefront as soon as you save.
pages.emptyBody: Create the first page — About or FAQ is a good place to start.
pages.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.

fields.bodyHint: The full text of the page — paragraph line breaks are kept.

pages.asideBody: Shoppers open this page at the address below.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.intro: The links that make up the store's header and footer menus. They feed the storefront navigation as soon as you save.
navigation.reorderHint: Use the arrows to change the order — the first link is the first one shoppers see.
navigation.headerHint: Shown at the top of every page of the store.
navigation.footerHint: Shown at the bottom of every page of the store.
navigation.empty: No links in this menu yet
navigation.emptyBody: Add the first link so shoppers can find their way around.

media.title: Media
media.intro: Every photograph and clip of the boutique in one place — copy a URL into any product, banner or page.
media.folderHint: Groups files for browsing; the URL works either way.
media.emptyBody: Drop photographs above — they appear here the moment they finish uploading.
media.uploadHint: Drag files onto this panel, or choose them. JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, MP4, WebM.
media.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file uploaded} other {# files uploaded}}
media.uploadedNew: Uploaded — the new file is in the grid.
media.maxSize: Up to 5 MB per file, maximum 10 at a time.
media.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the URL and copy it manually.
media.name: Display name
media.useHint: Tip: press Copy URL on a file, then paste it into an image field in Products, Banners or Pages.

users.title: Staff users
users.intro: The people who can sign in to the MALIKA admin, and the role each one holds.
users.emptyBody: Create an account for every colleague who needs to manage the store.
users.name: Name

user.newIntro: Grant a colleague access to the admin. The password is set now and can be reset later.
user.roleHint: The role decides what this account can see and do.
user.securityNote: Changing the role, deactivating the account or resetting the password automatically signs out every live session of that account.
user.resetIntro: The account is signed out of every active session as soon as the password changes.
user.passwordsMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.intro: A role is a named set of permissions; each staff account holds exactly one role.
roles.emptyBody: System roles are seeded automatically — add a custom role when you need a tailored set of permissions.

role.newIntro: Name the role, then tick the permissions it should grant.
role.editIntro: Rename the role or adjust the permissions it grants.
role.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.
role.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions selected} one {# permission selected} other {# permissions selected}}
role.lockedNotice: The Super Admin role always holds every permission, so its matrix is read-only.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.intro: Store-wide defaults: delivery pricing, delivery windows and the low-stock cut-off.
settings.readOnly: You can review these settings, but only accounts with the settings-management permission can change them.
settings.freeThresholdHint: Orders at or above this amount ship free.
settings.thresholdHint: The dashboard and the inventory list flag variants at or below this quantity as low stock.

alerts.title: New-order email alerts
alerts.intro: Add one or more email addresses to get an instant email with the details of every new order, the moment it is placed.
alerts.notConfigured: Email delivery isn't set up on the server yet. Add your SMTP details (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS) to the environment variables and restart the site, otherwise no emails will be sent.
alerts.enabled: Send an email for every new order

status.test: Test email sent. Check that it arrived (and look in your spam folder).

errors.limit: You've reached the maximum number of addresses (10).
errors.notFound: That email isn't in the list.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
errors.notConfigured: Email delivery isn't set up on the server (SMTP details missing).
errors.noRecipients: Add at least one email address first.
errors.sendFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Check your SMTP details (host, port, password).

theme.title: Theme
theme.intro: Recolour the boutique without leaving the logo's palette — unreadable combinations are blocked by the WCAG AA guard.
theme.radiusHint: 0 = sharp editorial edges, up to 16 = soft boutique curves.
theme.previewBody: Bias-cut satin that moves like a whisper — photographed in the Cairo atelier.
theme.contrastOk: Every text pair meets WCAG AA (≥ {ratio}:1).

pairs.darkBrandText: Dark mode: text on brand buttons

brand.title: Logo & favicon
brand.subtitle: changes apply across the whole site
brand.logoHint: Shown in the header, footer and loading screen. Transparent PNG works best.
brand.logoDarkHint: Used when dark mode is on. If empty, the main logo is used.
brand.faviconHint: The small icon in the browser tab. Square PNG, at least 192×192.
brand.savedNote: Saved. The site now uses these files.
brand.tooLarge: The image is larger than 5 MB.
brand.badType: Use a PNG, JPG, WebP or AVIF image.
brand.noPermission: Your role cannot upload to the media library.

seo.title: SEO
seo.intro: How MALIKA appears in search results and when links are shared — per language, site-wide.
seo.titleHint: Shown as the browser and search title; about 60 characters.
seo.ogImageHint: Used when the site is shared on messaging apps and social feeds.
seo.robotsHint: Turn off while the boutique is still private.
seo.previewHint: Approximate — search engines rewrite titles when they need to.
seo.previewEmptyTitle: Your site title will appear here
seo.previewEmptyDesc: Your meta description will appear here.
seo.indexedHint: Google and other crawlers may index every public page.
seo.blockedHint: Every page carries noindex — the boutique will not appear in search.

orders.title: Orders
orders.intro: Every order placed in the boutique, newest first. Search, filter, and move each order along its journey.
orders.emptyBody: New orders appear here the moment a customer checks out.

order.guest: Guest checkout — this order is not linked to an account.
order.noteHint: Staff only — the customer never sees this.
order.notePlaceholder: Context for the team: call attempts, special arrangements…
order.readNote: No internal note on this order.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Everyone with an account in the boutique, with what they have spent and when they last ordered.
customers.emptyBody: Customers appear here as soon as they create an account or place an order.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.intro: What customers say about each piece. Approve what deserves the storefront, reject what does not.
reviews.emptyBody: Reviews sent from product pages appear here for moderation.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.intro: Discount codes for campaigns, launches and loyal customers.
coupons.emptyBody: Create the first code so your next campaign can go live.

coupon.codeHint: Letters, numbers, dashes and underscores. Saved in upper case.
coupon.maxDiscountHint: Leave empty to allow the full discount.
coupon.perCustomerLimitHint: Leave empty for no per-customer cap.
coupon.restrictionsHint: All empty means the coupon applies to the whole order. Tick products, categories or collections to narrow it down.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.intro: Newsletter subscribers collected from the storefront.
marketing.noteBody: These addresses are collected by the newsletter form in the storefront footer. Every campaign send reads from this list — remove only addresses that asked to leave.
marketing.emptyBody: Anyone who joins through the footer newsletter shows up here.

audiences.title: Audiences
audiences.intro: Who your pieces are for — Women, Men, Kids or anything you like. Each product is assigned to one audience.
audiences.emptyBody: Create the first audience so products can be assigned to it.
audiences.slugHint: Letters, numbers and dashes only, e.g. kids. Leave blank to generate it from the English name. It cannot be changed later.
audiences.slugLocked: The slug cannot be changed after creation.
audiences.includeUnisexHint: When on, products marked for both genders also appear in this audience.
audiences.inUse: Products still use this audience — move them to another one first.

newsletter.title: Letters from the atelier
newsletter.body: New arrivals, private previews and quiet notes — once a week, never more.
newsletter.success: Welcome to the inner circle — keep an eye on your inbox.
